'''FC Hertha Wels''' is an [[Football in Austria|Austrian association football]] club from [[Wels]] that currently plays in the second-tier [[2. Liga (Austria)|2. Liga]]. The club was founded in 2024 by the merger of ''WSC Hertha Wels'' and ''FC Wels'', both of them also being fusion clubs of two predecessor clubs each.<ref>[http://www.fcwels.at/geschichte-3/ History] - FC Wels {{in lang|de}}</ref>

[[File:Wels Performance Graph.png|thumb|upright=1.2|Historical chart of the club and its predecessors' league performance]]"}}
